authoring.priorExposure: Frozen census proposal and candidate identities/counts, source history, workflow/imports, compiled prompt configuration, and repository compatibility rules only. No selected issue/PR body or candidate implementation was inspected before this contract.
authoring.effectiveExecutor: Frozen compiled workflow includes the actual runtime-imported breaking-change prompt and Copilot SDK execution. Specific historical execution and applied-output custody must be verified separately when claimed; an SDK/sample filename alone establishes neither replay nor live execution.

originalCensusProposal.goal: Prevent unintended breaking CLI changes according to the repository's compatibility rules.
originalCensusProposal.acceptance: An independent compatibility fixture or adjudicated rule application must verify actual command/flag/output/behavior incompatibilities and their remediation.
originalCensusProposal.limitation: A no-breaking-changes report, merge status or absence of findings cannot establish compatibility.

fullAcceptance: Correctly identify all relevant breaking changes in the source-required preceding 24 hours under the contemporaneous repository rules, and establish their remediation or explicitly approved breaking-release treatment. Completeness, actual user behavior, approvals, migration sufficiency and full historical coverage are not inferred from issue closure or merge.

nativePartial.formula: Count distinct existing CLI contract cases whose actual repair commit and real parent independently prove a broken existing command, flag, output, exit/default behavior or schema contract is restored, corroborated by an older immutable contract or independent compatibility fixture. Deduplicate repair commit plus affected public contract identity; a title, edit count, migration note or workflow-infrastructure repair is not a CLI restoration.
eligibility: Repair is on immutable bound repository history by cutoff and after actual workflow introduction.
Original issue/PR/run identities are retained; editable markers discover candidates but are not creation receipts.
Native before/after and independently established prior CLI contract prove the specified restoration without executing target code.
Downstream linkage is established separately from native restoration; shared corroboration is not sole causation or receipt-backed attribution.

selection.scope: All 45 marker-linked roots and all three related PR candidates in the already frozen workflow census; graph discovery may add directly linked downstream PRs, with explicit exhaustive/bounded pagination disposition.

periods.interval: Half-open delivery periods; each restoration belongs once to its actual repair-commit timestamp, never repeated snapshot stock.

unknownPolicy: No accepted native case means null useful outcome, not measured whole-workflow zero. Rejected or unavailable candidates remain separately inspectable. Synthetic checker positives do not qualify real coverage.
separateUnknowns: Full goal attainment and all-period or all-candidate completeness
Receipt-backed workflow contribution, sole causation and attributable costs
Keep decision without an explicitly agreed native threshold

acquisition.transport: Public read-only gh API originals with SHA-256 custody and bounded pagination
